it: \bAlfredo: Salve, giovane. Il mio nome è Alfredo.

\bAlfredo: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Gelo.

en: \bPryce: The bond you have with your Pokémon is incredible. Don't ever lose sight of it.

id: \bI haven't had a battle like that in years.
en: \bI haven't had a battle like that in years.
it: \bNon facevo una lotta così da anni.

en: \bWho would have known I would lose?

en: \bThey are strong against Dragon, Flying, Grass, and Ground. They are resistant to only Ice.
